name: InterContinental Century City Chengdu
insider_take: This sleek high-rise stands as Chengdu's gateway to luxury, where ancient Sichuan culture meets contemporary sophistication in China's most livable city.
whats_special: The InterContinental Century City towers above Chengdu's bustling financial district, offering panoramic views of the city where giant pandas roam and spicy hotpot reigns supreme. Its location puts you minutes from Tianfu Square and the historic Jinli Ancient Street, while the hotel's Club InterContinental floors provide exclusive access to some of the city's best skyline vistas.
pro_tip: Book a room on the higher floors facing west for stunning sunset views over the Qingcheng Mountains, and don't miss the hotel's authentic Sichuan cuisine at their signature restaurant.
dont_miss: The nearby Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding (20 minutes away) and the vibrant Kuanzhai Xiangzi (Wide and Narrow Alleys) historic district, perfect for experiencing traditional teahouse culture and sampling legendary Sichuan street food.
pros: Premium location in Chengdu's modern business district
Luxurious amenities and world-class InterContinental service standards
Contemporary design with sophisticated guest rooms and suites
cons: Urban location may lack traditional cultural atmosphere
